contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), Emperor standing issue of 367-375, Arles mint, Reece period 19. Pierced at 6 O'clock obverse. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Emperor standing right with shield and labarum; [OF] III in field. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 1.41gms, die axis: 6
